chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, who said:
I wrote to Abu Muhammad عليه السلام asking him whether one may perform salat (prayer) in a cap made of pure silk or a cap of dibaj. So he عليه السلام wrote: Salat (prayer) is not lawful in pure silk.

key_terms.أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, the Imam عليه السلام being addressed in the narration

ai.seo_question: Is salat (prayer) valid while wearing a cap made of pure silk?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Abu Muhammad عليه السلام regarding salat (prayer) in garments made of pure silk. It states that salat (prayer) is not permissible in pure silk, establishing a jurisprudential ruling concerning prayer attire.
